body:
Hi Jane,

It was nice talking to you yesterday as well.

Regarding your question, we do have this data source, called "Call Logs" and "SMS Logs". They provide the following data fields:

 - User ID
 - Device type
 - Contact phone number
 - Length (characters in SMS or duration in phone calls)
 - Type (incoming, outgoing, missed, etc.)

And they are available in both Android and iOS. The caveat is that due to sensitivity of this information, our stock app does not have permissions to collect this data. If your study needs to collect this data, we would need to create a branded application for your study, submit it to the App Store and Google Play along with Ethics Approval that confirms the requirements for collecting such that, and then we can collect it. We can take care of everything on our end of course, just wanted to share why you may not see this in our Learn documentation.

Hope it helps,
Amin
